The result stays among the versions of the DEM.

Without a hold a nadir block over flat ground bends into a dome while the reprojection error stays the same: if the optimisation takes the cameras away from their accurate positions (beyond 3 times the offset before and 30 cm more), the alignment before it is put back - either it bent the block, or the positions disagree with the control points; to keep it, untick the cameras in the Reference pane. texts.Ogni cella del DEM viene proiettata nell: Every cell of the DEM is projected into the scene through its RPCs and the scene is read there. The full result (all the bands, the type of the scene) goes to <data>/satellite/, an 8-bit rendition stays among the versions of the orthomosaic to compare it with the drone's. RPCs use ellipsoidal heights: with a DEM in orthometric heights give the geoid undulation.
texts.Ogni chunk con un DEM è una fase dello s: Every chunk with a DEM is a phase of the excavation, in the order of the dates (from the photos, or written here). The units drawn on a phase were exposed then and dug away before the next phase: what was removed is measured and, where they overlap in plan, they are proposed as covering the units exposed later.
texts.Ogni chunk resta com'è (foto, nuvole, me: Every chunk stays as it is (photos, clouds, meshes): only its transformation changes, bringing it into the system of the reference chunk. With points the initial position comes from markers, georeference or common photos, else from the shape of the clouds. DEMs and orthophotos of the aligned chunks must be built again.
texts.Ogni foto 360° diventa sei foto prospett: Every 360° photo becomes six perspective photos, the faces of a cube, in the «facce_360» folder beside the photos. texts.Ogni unità senza numero riceve una US: l: Every unit without a number gets a US: the highest first, USM where the classified cloud says masonry, with area, elevations and colour measured. The relationships come from the contacts: the unit higher along the contact covers the other, a unit enclosed in another and not higher is the fill of a cut (proposed too), layers abut walls. Number, type and definition can be corrected in the table; double click to see the unit on the orthomosaic. The units drawn with their number but without a form in PyArchInit keep it; those that have their form count only for the relations.

formats.Bundle adjustment globale di posizioni,:
Global bundle adjustment of positions, orientations and calibration. With 3 or more control points the GCPs enter the computation as points fixed at their coordinates: the block bends to pass through them (it also corrects deformations such as the dome of a wrong distortion, not only the rotation and translation). The check points ({0}) stay out and measure the result.

The scale bars (two or more, or together with the GCPs) enter as in Metashape: the markers at their ends are fixed where the bars have their length, moved as much as their precision in the photos allows, and the block bends towards them as much as the photos allow. A single bar gives only the scale. The check bars measure the result.

The own engine does not fix the GCPs: it pulls them to their coordinates by their accuracy, keeps the bars as distances between the markers, can use the GNSS positions of the photos estimating a bias per flight (RTK base on a wrong point, antenna offset) and the velocity of every photo while the sensor is read (rolling shutter of drones). Over flat ground with nadir photos only the vertical bias trades off with the focal length: GCPs or oblique photos are needed.
